01 Database — Statistics

Feed telemetry and published packages.

The package metadata is stored inside the JSql engine as plain json tables, while the physical .nupkg files live in the configured data directory. Everything below is computed live from the server json api.

06 Protocol Endpoints

Upload is only available through the xGet client using the experimental TOTP authentication. Download is anonymous and follows the standard NuGet v3 flat container layout.
